description: Reference frames for the TC421 UDP protocol. Every frame is 64 bytes, hex-encoded (128 lowercase characters). The MAC is fictitious. 'status' is 'observed' when the exchange was seen working on a real controller, 'derived-unverified' when it is only deduced from the specification. Requests: 'call' names the builder, 'params' its arguments (offsets and checksum follow docs/PROTOCOL.md). Responses: 'expected' is what a reader must extract; the checksum byte of a response must never be checked.

vectors.name: search
vectors.description: Discovery request (17). No MAC in the frame. Sent by broadcast or, as observed, by unicast.

vectors.name: time_sync
vectors.description: Set the controller clock (02) to 2026-11-11 14:44:26. Acknowledged with 0x85 on a real unit.

vectors.name: start_download
vectors.description: Open the write of a program (01 01): slot 3, name "Aquarium". Never tested on a real unit.

vectors.name: start_download_slot0_short_name
vectors.description: Open the write of a program (01 01): slot 0, name "A". Never tested on a real unit.

vectors.name: download_step_first
vectors.description: Write step 0 (01 02): 00:00, all channels off. Never tested on a real unit.

vectors.name: download_step_mid
vectors.description: Write step 17 (01 02): 08:30, channels 100/90/100/100/0. Never tested on a real unit.

vectors.name: download_step_last
vectors.description: Write step 47 (01 02): 23:30, channels 1/2/3/4/5. Never tested on a real unit.

vectors.name: stop_all_process
vectors.description: End of a program write (04 0A). Role deduced from the original app. Never tested on a real unit.

vectors.name: stop_process
vectors.description: End of preview / back to the stored program (03 08). Acknowledged with 0x83 on a real unit.

vectors.name: preview_start
vectors.description: Start a preview (06 01), name "test". No reply on a real unit.

vectors.name: preview_values
vectors.description: Live preview values (06 02), five channels at 10 %. No reply on a real unit.

vectors.name: wifi_ssid_wpa2_aes
vectors.description: Join a protected network, step 1 (18, sub-command 1 at byte 6, text from byte 7): SSID, WPA2 (2) and AES (1) at offsets 39 and 40. Acknowledged with 0x70. Never tested on a real unit.

vectors.name: wifi_ssid_wpa_tkip_max_length
vectors.description: Join a protected network, step 1 (18, sub-command 1 at byte 6, text from byte 7): 32-byte SSID, WPA (1) and TKIP (2). Never tested on a real unit.

vectors.name: wifi_password
vectors.description: Join a protected network, step 2 (18, sub-command 2): passphrase. Acknowledged with 0x72. Never tested on a real unit.

vectors.name: wifi_open_ssid
vectors.description: Join an open network (18, sub-command 3): SSID only. Acknowledged with 0x74. Never tested on a real unit.

vectors.name: reply_discovery
vectors.description: Discovery reply as observed: MAC in bytes 4..15, byte 61 not significant (formula unknown).

vectors.name: ack_time_sync
vectors.description: Acknowledgement of 02 as observed: byte 2 is 0x03 (not the command), ack code 0x85 at byte 4 overwriting the first MAC character, MAC again at 49..60. Bytes 16..48 assumed zero (not captured). Byte 61 not significant.

vectors.name: ack_stop_process
vectors.description: Acknowledgement of 03 08 as observed: byte 2 is 0x11, ack code 0x83. Bytes 16..48 assumed zero (not captured). Byte 61 not significant.
